notes: After granting admin consent the new tab now lands on a confirmation page instead of a 404 — backend pointed the consent redirect at /api/onboarding/consent-callback all along, the portal just didn't have a handler there. Success shows the consenting tenant + a Close this tab button; failures show the Microsoft error code and description so you know what went wrong

Activation errors now show the actual Microsoft Graph reason (e.g. Authorization_RequestDenied — Insufficient privileges to complete the operation) instead of the generic 'Bundle activation failed during Microsoft Graph operations' wrapper, plus a one-liner pointing at Setup-BasewiserPlatform.ps1 step 3 which is where the missing identity scopes get granted. Button label flips to Retry activate after a failure
